    (i) Show that CG\C^{G}CG, with pointwise product, Δ(δg)=∑hk=gδh⊗δk\Delta(\delta_g)=\sum_{hk=g}\delta_h\otimes\delta_kΔ(δg​)=∑hk=g​δh​⊗δk​, εH(δg)=δg,1\varepsilon_H(\delta_g)=\delta_{g,1}εH​(δg​)=δg,1​ and SH(δg)=δg−1S_H(\delta_g)=\delta_{g^{-1}}SH​(δg​)=δg−1​, is a Hopf algebra.

    (iii) Draw the bialgebra law Equation (8.1) for C[G]\C[G]C[G] on g⊗hg\otimes hg⊗h, and conclude that Rep(C[G])\Rep(\C[G])Rep(C[G]) is Rep(G)\Rep(G)Rep(G) with its tensor product.

(ii) Vg=δgVV_g=\delta_gVVg​=δg​V; Δ(δk)\Delta(\delta_k)Δ(δk​) is non-zero on Vg⊗WhV_g\otimes W_hVg​⊗Wh​ only for k=ghk=ghk=gh; δk\delta_kδk​ acts on V∗V^{*}V∗ as δk−1T\delta_{k^{-1}}^{T}δk−1T​.   5. Exercise 5 No fibre functor

    A fibre functor Φ\PhiΦ is a faithful C\CC-linear monoidal functor to Vectfd\VectfdVectfd​ (Lecture 8). You may use that a C\CC-linear functor between semisimple categories preserves direct sums.

    (i) Show that a fibre functor on Fibonacci would give an integer n=dim⁡Φ(τ)n=\dim\Phi(\tau)n=dimΦ(τ) with n2=n+1n^{2}=n+1n2=n+1, and conclude that there is none. Do the same for Ising.

    (ii) The semion category has every FPdim\mathrm{FPdim}FPdim equal to 111. Show with Sheet 3, Exercise 4, that it has no fibre functor either.

    (iii) Why does this not contradict the existence of a fibre functor on VecG\VecGVecG​ for G=Z3G=\Z_3G=Z3​ with the pivotal structure d=e2πi/3d=e^{2\pi i/3}d=e2πi/3 of Lecture 4?

    Show a hint

    (i) Φ(τ)⊗Φ(τ)≅Φ(τ⊗τ)\Phi(\tau)\otimes\Phi(\tau)\cong\Phi(\tau\otimes\tau)Φ(τ)⊗Φ(τ)≅Φ(τ⊗τ). (ii) Each Φ(δg)\Phi(\delta_g)Φ(δg​) is a line.

    Show the answer

    (i) n2=dim⁡Φ(1⊕τ)=1+nn^{2}=\dim\Phi(1\oplus\tau)=1+nn2=dimΦ(1⊕τ)=1+n has roots φ\varphiφ, −1/φ-1/\varphi−1/φ; Ising: dim⁡Φ(ψ)2=1\dim\Phi(\psi)^{2}=1dimΦ(ψ)2=1, then (dim⁡Φ(σ))2=2(\dim\Phi(\sigma))^{2}=2(dimΦ(σ))2=2. (ii) Identifying each Φ(δg)\Phi(\delta_g)Φ(δg​) with C\CC makes Φ\PhiΦ a functor of Sheet 3’s kind, which needs ω=δj\omega=\delta jω=δj. (iii) A fibre functor sees FPdim\mathrm{FPdim}FPdim (here 111), not the pivotal ddd.

    Show the worked method

    (i) Φ\PhiΦ is monoidal, so Φ(1)≅C\Phi(1)\cong\CΦ(1)≅C and Φ(τ)⊗Φ(τ)≅Φ(τ⊗τ)≅Φ(1⊕τ)≅Φ(1)⊕Φ(τ)\Phi(\tau)\otimes\Phi(\tau)\cong\Phi(\tau\otimes\tau)\cong\Phi(1\oplus\tau)\cong\Phi(1)\oplus\Phi(\tau)Φ(τ)⊗Φ(τ)≅Φ(τ⊗τ)≅Φ(1⊕τ)≅Φ(1)⊕Φ(τ), using that Φ\PhiΦ preserves direct sums. Taking dimensions, n2=1+nn^{2}=1+nn2=1+n with n=dim⁡Φ(τ)n=\dim\Phi(\tau)n=dimΦ(τ) a non-negative integer. Its roots are φ\varphiφ and −1/φ-1/\varphi−1/φ, neither an integer (and n=0n=0n=0 would make Φ\PhiΦ kill τ\tauτ, against faithfulness). So Fibonacci has no fibre functor. For a Hopf algebra HHH the forgetful functor Rep(H)→Vectfd\Rep(H)\to\VectfdRep(H)→Vectfd​ is one (it is strict monoidal by Theorem 8.2, and faithful), so Fibonacci is not Rep(H)\Rep(H)Rep(H); Theorem 8.8 gives the converse. For Ising, ψ⊗ψ≅1\psi\otimes\psi\cong1ψ⊗ψ≅1 gives dim⁡Φ(ψ)2=1\dim\Phi(\psi)^{2}=1dimΦ(ψ)2=1, so dim⁡Φ(ψ)=1\dim\Phi(\psi)=1dimΦ(ψ)=1, and σ⊗σ≅1⊕ψ\sigma\otimes\sigma\cong1\oplus\psiσ⊗σ≅1⊕ψ gives nσ2=2n_\sigma^{2}=2nσ2​=2 for nσ=dim⁡Φ(σ)n_\sigma=\dim\Phi(\sigma)nσ​=dimΦ(σ): no integer.

    (ii) In VecGω\VecG[\omega]VecGω​ on Z2\Z_2Z2​, dim⁡Φ(s)2=dim⁡Φ(1)=1\dim\Phi(s)^{2}=\dim\Phi(1)=1dimΦ(s)2=dimΦ(1)=1, so each Φ(δg)\Phi(\delta_g)Φ(δg​) is a line. Choose isomorphisms Φ(δg)≅C\Phi(\delta_g)\cong\CΦ(δg​)≅C; transported along them, Φ\PhiΦ becomes a monoidal functor that sends each δg\delta_gδg​ to C\CC, with structure maps Jg,hJ_{g,h}Jg,h​ numbers, as in Sheet 3, Exercise 4(ii). There it was shown that such a functor exists only if ω=δj\omega=\delta jω=δj, and in Exercise 4(iii) that ω(s,s,s)=−1\omega(s,s,s)=-1ω(s,s,s)=−1 is not a coboundary. So the semion category has none, although its FPdim\mathrm{FPdim}FPdim’s are integers: integer dimensions are necessary, not sufficient.

    (iii) The obstruction in (i) is FPdim\mathrm{FPdim}FPdim, which a fibre functor turns into ordinary dimensions. The pivotal dimension ddd depends on a pivotal structure, which Φ\PhiΦ need not respect. On VecZ3\catname{Vec}_{\Z_3}VecZ3​​ every FPdim\mathrm{FPdim}FPdim is 111 and the forgetful functor is a fibre functor, whatever pivotal structure we put on the category; d=e2πi/3d=e^{2\pi i/3}d=e2πi/3 is no obstruction.
